title: Century of Conflict: The Hundred-Years’ War
tagline: A century of conflict. Thousands of lives. History is not yet written.

approval.evidence: Adopted campaign scope and reclassification per explicit user direction; existing separate campaign authority.

public.synopsis: A persistent historical world centered on the Hundred Years’ War and surrounding societies, with selectable historical entry points, careers, affiliations, and independent character pathways. Kingdoms, armies, towns, businesses, families, and institutions operate through actual resources and competing interests. The war is historical context, not a forced player career.

design.scope_statement: Multiregional political, economic and social simulation
design.core_3_3_verification: document_reference_only; runtime capability not certified by this catalogue
design.core_integration_policy: inherit Core; propose upstream changes by CMRR; do not replicate shared resource/state owners
design.player_agency_requirement: Do not invent player speech, thoughts, motives, travel, allegiance, or voluntary decisions.
design.persistent_state_requirement: Maintain coherent records of actors, knowledge, time, possessions, ownership, transit, work, and consequences.
design.source_archive: Established Century of Conflict / Hundred Years War campaign materials (separate project)
additional_dependencies: Historical start profiles, including approved ten primary dates
Historical setting library and legal/social institutions
